Consensus formula: consensusScore = 1.0×ytIndependent + 1.0×sendIt + 0.1×min(rawVideos−ytIndependent,20) + 0.5×bookAlign − 1.0×(N3 fail) − 0.5×(N2 or N8 fail)
Tiers: Rules 1–2 skipped by user; Send it not required for Clear (still scored, scraped every run). Clear = 3+ independent YT + all applicable rules 3–8, N1–N10b pass; N10 keeps one Clear per game side/total. EV is info only; edge+ (best EV > 0 incl. soft books vs Pinnacle no-vig) ranks first within Clear/Soft. Score weights: social ×0.5 in strong markets without sharp/RLM agreement, ×source perf multiplier, ±1 sharp/RLM.
Ranking ≠ bet. Rules 1, 2 skipped by user: EV / line-shopping shown as info only. Clear = 3+ independent YT, 2+ Send it, all applicable rules pass. Gate fails are shown on each card.

  • • Pinnacle guest API (22 leagues: EPL, LaLiga/LaLiga 2, Serie A, Ligue 1/2, Eerste Divisie, Liga Portugal, Süper Lig, Brasileirão A/B, Argentina, Colombia, Peru, Chile, Ecuador, Uruguay, Bolivia, Allsvenskan, Superliga, Greece, Russia) snapshots refreshed at build time
  • • Action Network public splits + soft-book prices (DraftKings, FanDuel, BetRivers, BetMGM, bet365, Caesars) where listed; Pinnacle open-to-current line moves for sharp/RLM
  • • ESPN scoreboards for the same 22 competitions (kickoff times and status); games that kicked off before the brief was final are excluded
  • • Models: Understat xG Poisson (EPL, LaLiga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1), football-data.co.uk goals Poisson (National League, LaLiga 2, Serie B, 2. Bundesliga, Ligue 2, Liga Portugal, Pro League), Elo (Eredivisie, MLS, Liga MX); shrunk 50% toward market. Other leagues market-only (rule 8 n/a)
  • • BTTS fair derived from Pinnacle team totals (Poisson); double chance from Pinnacle 1X2 power devig; DNB = Pinnacle AH 0
  • • Library rules: rules 3–8, N1–N10b, D1–D13 (rules 1–2 skipped by user); parlays/accas counted as single legs at half weight, never as parlays; quarter-Kelly stake, 0 at EV ≤ 0
